createRoom.label: Create Room
createRoom.description: Create a new Webex room (space). The authenticated user is automatically added as a member.

title.label: Room Title
title.description: A user-friendly name for the room

description.label: Description
description.description: The description of the room. Required if isPublic is true.

teamId.label: Team ID
teamId.description: The ID for the team with which this room is associated (optional)

isPublic.label: Public Room
isPublic.description: Make the room public and discoverable within the org. Note: description is required if this is true.

isLocked.label: Locked/Moderated
isLocked.description: Set the space as locked/moderated. The creator becomes a moderator.

isAnnouncementOnly.label: Announcement Only
isAnnouncementOnly.description: Sets the space into announcement mode. Only moderators can post messages. Note: space must be locked (moderated) to enable this.

createTeam.label: Create Team
createTeam.description: Create a new Webex team. The authenticated user is automatically added as a member.

name.label: Team Name
name.description: A user-friendly name for the team

findMessage.label: Find Message
findMessage.description: Retrieve details for a specific message by message ID

messageId.label: Message ID
messageId.description: The unique identifier for the message

findRoom.label: Find room
findRoom.description: Retrieve details for a specific room by room id
